registration.limitation: Integer-pixel image peaks; matching can be biased by morphology, PSF or wavelength. Stationarity and source identity are unverified.

variance.method: sum of squared bilinear weights for each independent input; then A+B
variance.limitation: Diagonal variance only; input/output covariance, background-fit error and calibration systematics are not modeled. Not used as calibrated significance.

blocking_checks.explanation: Both images use surface brightness in MJy/sr.
Variance is propagated through bilinear resampling when usable; correlated noise and PSF matching remain unmodeled.
Calibrated per-pixel wavelength and response equivalence have not been established. WCS-WAVE values are approximate visualization metadata.
PSF models are recorded, but spatially varying PSF matching has not been validated.
The images were mapped to the same sky grid; stationary reference sources have not verified the alignment.
Matching units or pipeline versions do not establish matching photometric calibration.
